local_context.summary: A trial corpus contains a protocol, primary report, and differently titled companion analysis linked by acronym and registration ID; the result set requires trial-level rows.
local_context.corrective_route: use explicit trial identifiers and source statements to keep reports as evidence for one trial-level entity rather than separate rows

fixtures.research_scope: Create one result row per unique randomized salt-substitution trial represented in the supplied corpus, and report whether this supplied corpus is sufficient to enumerate that trial set.

source_documents.title: Salt-substitution corpus inventory
source_documents.text: This closed corpus contains every publication in the collection: one protocol, one primary cardiovascular outcomes article, and one prespecified renal outcomes article. All three records carry trial registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212; no other randomized trial is represented in this corpus.

source_documents.title: Rationale and design of the Salt Substitute and Stroke Study
source_documents.text: The Salt Substitute and Stroke Study (SSaSS), registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212, is an unblinded cluster-randomized trial in 600 rural Chinese villages.

source_documents.title: Effect of Salt Substitution on Cardiovascular Events and Death
source_documents.text: In SSaSS (ChiCTR-TRC-12002212), 20,995 participants were randomized by village. This article reports the prespecified primary cardiovascular outcomes.

source_documents.title: Potassium-Enriched Salt and Serious Renal Events in Rural China
source_documents.text: This prespecified renal analysis uses the same randomized participants and allocation from SSaSS, trial registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212; it did not recruit or randomize a separate cohort.
